fit: dried ground oregano in healthy soldiers and exercise blood biomarkers
assessment: The 500 mg dried plant capsule is close to the named preparation. In 24 healthy soldiers, creatine kinase was lower than starch at 60 and 120 minutes (both p < 0.0001). The study measured no anxiety or patient fatigue scale and did not specify plant part. No symptom direction transfers.

fit: ginger capsules and menstrual pain against an active comparator
assessment: In 122 students, two-cycle maximum pain scores were 43.49 and 38.19 mm for ginger versus 39.01 and 33.75 mm for mefenamic acid (both inconclusive). No placebo arm, equivalence margin, grated ginger intervention or Parkinson pain outcome.
